description: Upgrades a Ceph cluster following strict daemon order: MGR → MON → OSD → RGW → MDS. Sets noout before upgrade to prevent rebalancing. Ceph does not support downgrade — rollback surfaces daemon state for operator.

target_version.label: Target Version
target_version.description: Target Ceph version (e.g. 19.2 for Squid). Must be +1 release.

mgr_hosts.label: MGR Hosts
mgr_hosts.description: List of {host} for Ceph manager daemons

mon_hosts.label: MON Hosts
mon_hosts.description: List of {host} for Ceph monitor daemons

osd_hosts.label: OSD Hosts
osd_hosts.description: List of {host} for Ceph OSD daemons

rgw_hosts.label: RGW Hosts
rgw_hosts.description: Optional list of {host} for Ceph RADOS Gateway daemons

mds_hosts.label: MDS Hosts
mds_hosts.description: Optional list of {host} for Ceph Metadata Server daemons (CephFS)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: Ceph does not support version downgrade. Rollback surfaces which daemons are on new vs old version. Operators must use RBD snapshots or CephFS snapshots for data recovery if cluster is unhealthy.
